item.description:
SEVENTEEN 2026 JAPAN FANMEETING 'YAKUSOKU' in KYOCERA DOME OSAKA (2026.5.24) [Weverse] (1080p HD)​


​
The SEVENTEEN 2026 JAPAN FANMEETING 'YAKUSOKU' in OSAKA took place on May 23 and 24, 2026, at the Kyocera Dome Osaka. The sold-out, two-day event drew approximately 80,000 fans and featured a 3.5-hour program of talk segments, games, and an 18-song setlist, including the live debut of "Tiny Light". The event in Osaka was highly successful, drawing online live-streaming audiences from 73 countries and regions. The fan meeting served as a continuation of their Tokyo Dome dates, where they performed for another 100,000 fans.
​
